test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_json_duplicate_key_check_src (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_json_duplicate_key_check_src SELECT concat('{', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('"key_', toString((number % 3) * 80 + i), '":', toString(number + i)), range(80)), ','), ',', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(g -> concat('"object_', toString((number % 10) + g), '":{', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('"field_', toString(i), '":"v', toString(i), '"'), range(5)), ','), '}'), range(4)), ','), '}') FROM numbers(100000)
test.query: SELECT s::{json_type} FROM t_json_duplicate_key_check_src FORMAT Null
